explanation: Answers erdosproblems.com/296 with k(N) = (1 - o(1)) log N, so not o(log N). It combines the trivial bound k ≤ H_N (disjoint blocks each of reciprocal sum 1 inside [1,N]) with the Hunter–Sawhney/Bloom lower bound that ⌊(1 - ε) log N⌋ disjoint decompositions exist for large N. This is a faithful encoding of the asymptotic answer. Formal proof linked.
